builder (unix): the menu waits and redraws without starting processes, and it no longer quits after 50 s of idle -- on macOS the Terminal title flickered between "dd bs=1 count=1", "sleep", "stty" and the like, since bash 3.2's read cannot wait less than a second and the tick ran stty and dd five times a second, and the background loops slept, grepped and moved files as often. On macOS the script now continues under /bin/zsh --emulate sh, whose read waits 0.2 s itself (read -k -t -u); the background loops use zsh's builtins (zselect for the pauses, zf_mv, zf_mkdir, zstat), the Cargo log is counted by reading it as it grows instead of grep and wc, step names, colour-code stripping, agreements and the disk row are shell expansions, and the window size is measured only after a resize (WINCH). Linux keeps bash 4. The crash the user saw after Amp and Scope opened: the idle one-second wait added with the inline builds counted bash 3.2's timeout (status 1) as closed input and gave up after 50 of them; timed waits that took their time are timeouts now. The exit trap logs the exit status (and the last failed line) or that a signal closed the Builder, and a closed terminal says so in builder.log. Checked in a pty under zsh (entered as sh, as curl | sh does) and bash 3.2: log-in, the menu and the Experiments node, inline builds, the queue, s, cancel, Compile all and its cancel, the update beside a build, scrolling, resizing, OSC 11 dark and light, 65 s idle; ps sampling of the Builder's children while idle and while compiling shows only cargo, rustc and the build's own tools, no dd, sleep, stty, date, grep or mv

map_build: the repacker builds on Windows again -- repack and repack_remote read and wrote at offsets through Unix's FileExt, so makepad-map-build stopped compiling for Windows (the CI's workspace row, red since 01a02d4eb). A ReadExactAt shim gives read_exact_at and write_all_at on every platform: Unix's FileExt, and on Windows the same from seek_read/seek_write; repack_remote is built wherever repack is. Checked: cargo check of makepad-map-tiles' bins for the host and x86_64-pc-windows-gnu, the repack lib tests
